title: ID0444398-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S2 170003340] High volume of Logs Transmission
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: High volume of Logs Transmission
Solution:
Chargers are working fine - there was a reboot or shutdown and logs were coming from the past days/weeks/months.
R&D is already aware of the clogging in ticket
https://jira.si.siemens.cloud/browse/EVC3-9913
Close ticket - not service related anymore.
